## Summary

`hh-acp` is a records-in/records-out edge (binding (c) — a client): it
negotiates the pinned era, renders the single-source session artefact the
compiler lowers, moves permissions through the kernel's Π seam (never an
adapter-level approval), answers the `_hh/*` methods, replays the durable
tail on `session/resume`, and projects the A2A edge exhaustively. The
paused `input_required` call stays non-terminal — ask + elicitation, same
`effect_id`, `attempt_no + 1`, `requestState` echoed byte-for-byte.

**`hh-acp` (new crate).** `protocol` (`acp_binding`, `acp_pin_set`,
`negotiate_era`, `ACP_VERSION="0.1.0"` + the v1 compatibility profile);
`artifact` (`hh-acp-target/1` — schema/content hash, `render_session`,
`edge_loss_report`, ext members byte-for-byte); `transport`
(`SessionTransport` + a thread-safe in-memory pair); `driver` (scripted
session agent — durable-before-visible: `state_update{idle}` never
precedes `lifecycle.turn.finished`); `permission` (`request_permission`
only when `security.permission.requested{decider: human}` exists; cancel
→ `action.effect.refused`; nothing dispatches before
`security.permission.decided`; `allow_always` → ledgered amendment or
`allow_once`); `serve` (the `session/*` verbs, `_hh/ledger/read` /
`_hh/account` / `_hh/participant/describe`, `session/resume` replay,
`subscriptions/listen`, `configOptions[]`,
`session/new.mcpServers[] → pending_review` — never silently activated);
`client` (`attach_session` — three v1 hosts → descriptors with
`observability_level {events, end_state}`, no `ledger`, unknown controls
(`steer`/`fork`/`compaction`/`subagents`), component metrics `n/a`);
`a2a` (exhaustive `TaskState` — `INPUT_REQUIRED` resumes the child run;
`AgentCard{version: bundle_id}` signature verifies under the fixture
`TrustRootPolicy`, fails closed under a wrong root).

**`hh-mcp`.** `executor` (new — `McpExecutor`: observed → `Ok`;
`input_required` → `Paused{request_state}`; `isError` → tool plane;
JSON-RPC error → transport plane; unclassifiable → transport);
`http` (new — Streamable HTTP serve loop + `HttpTransport`;
`OriginPolicy` exact-match allowlist, fail-closed; the request body is
drained before any refusal — an early close with unread inbound data
resets and swallows the refusal; `401` + `WWW-Authenticate`
`resource_metadata` challenge; `Mcp-Session-Id` on `initialize`;
catalogue-hash change queues `list_changed` for `subscriptions/listen`);
`oauth` (new — OAuth 2.1 authorization-code + PKCE S256 + RFC 8707
audience + RFC 9207 issuer binding; the bearer stays in transport/H3
custody — only a fingerprint is ledgerable); `client`
(`call_tool_keyed` → `tools/call.params.target`); `server` (`target`
name-keyed dedup).

**`hh-env` / `hh-ledger`.** `TerminalStatus::Paused`,
`ExecutionRequest.request_state` (opaque — never kernel-parsed),
`DispatchOutcome::Paused`, `resume_paused` (typed refusal without the
pause trail; same `effect_id`; `attempt_no + 1`; requestState echo;
attempt-1 commit evidence reused, never re-emitted); the new audit-grade
`action.effect.input_required` class + non-terminal paused lifecycle.

**`hh-compiler`.** `acp` (new — `lower_event`/`AcpDialect` single-source
lowering table, tool-kind/task-state projections, `lower_target` + `lift`
for `hh-acp-target/1`, `PartialHIR` recovery, configuration-granularity
loss report); `target.rs` dispatch.

## Acceptance criteria (deterministic rows are executable)

- **AC-R-2.5.4-5** — v2 client fixture completes
  `initialize → session/new → session/prompt → updates → state_update{idle}`;
  updates resolve through `trace_map`; `idle` follows durable
  `lifecycle.turn.finished`: `ac_r_2_5_4_5_full_turn_updates_trace_to_durable_events`
  + `ac_r_2_5_4_5_idle_never_before_durable_finished`.
- **AC-R-2.5.4-6** — `request_permission` iff `decider: human`; cancel →
  `action.effect.refused`; no dispatch before `decided`; `allow_always` →
  amendment/`allow_once`: `ac_r_2_5_4_6_{request_permission_iff_decider_human,
  permission_round_trip_deny_never_executes, cancelled_maps_to_refusal_record}`.
- **AC-R-2.5.4-7** — three v1 hosts → compat descriptors (`observability_level
  {events,end_state}`, no `ledger`, unknown controls, metrics `n/a`); hosted
  auto-approval still through Π:
  `ac_r_2_5_4_7_three_v1_hosts_yield_compat_descriptors` +
  `ac_r_2_5_4_7_v2_descriptor_admits_ledger_observability`.
- **AC-R-2.5.4-10** — exhaustive `TaskState` (INPUT_REQUIRED resumes);
  card version = bundle id; signature verifies under the fixture root and
  fails under a wrong root:
  `ac_r_2_5_4_10_{task_state_projection_is_exhaustive,
  input_required_round_trip_resumes,
  card_version_is_bundle_id_and_signs, delegate_task_record_shape}`.
- **removability(0…3)** — `check-removability.sh` green; `hh-acp` is
  edge-free (records-in/out; no base crate names it).
- **DF-S3.9-1 → closed** — `df_s3_9_1_*` acceptance pair + `hh-mcp`
  executor pause/resume tests + `ac_e4_12_input_required_pause_and_resume`.
